scope: Method reproduction on pinned author code with dated 2024 Aliengo physics; not a certified original release or numerical reproduction.

timing_repair_table1.claim: No success-rate gain over author timing was established.

supported_findings: All three methods completed the 60 s Figure 3 tracking experiment.
10,000-rollout naive/MPPI solved in about 0.96 ms on this RTX 5080; acados about 1.09 ms on this CPU.
Frequency increased under the 40 N push and returned to nominal; adaptive tracking error was lower.
Adaptive gait improved 60 s completion and time to fall on the 50 matched seeds; paired exact McNemar p=0.015625, Holm p=0.03125 for the two controls.
not_reproduced: Published Table I success rates 32/37/80 percent; the paper omits episode duration and complete wrench schedule.
The Figure 4 acados fall; both methods survived our declared world-y command and 2-5 s push.
The claimed 21 kg mass; both historical and modern author models are about 24.638 kg.
